selection_rules:
(all on seed-averaged dev means of runs with no failures):
  best fixed   highest completed tasks/min among the fixed (K, J) rows and FIFO;
               ties go to the lower mean per-run P95.
  B2F          the best affinity-fixed row is kept only if it beats best fixed.
  fixed TTL    highest tasks/min among the TTL rows.
  queue rule   attained-service replaces continuation only if it is faster on dev.
  aging        among joint-a* rows, the highest tasks/min whose short-task slowdown
               is no worse than best fixed's; if none qualifies, the fairest one.
  final        the system repeated in eval trials and run under sensitivity: among
               cache, the chosen joint row and joint-checkpoint, the highest tasks/min
               whose short-task slowdown is no worse than best fixed's; if none
               qualifies, the fairest one; joint when none of them was run.
  short cutoff median expected output tokens of the dev tasks.
notes: best fixed: fixed-k2-j2 (1.069 tasks/min; candidates: fixed-k2-j2=1.069, fixed-k1-j1=0.8692, fixed-k2-j3=0.728, fixed-k2-j4=0.7169, fifo=0.7108, fixed-k1-jinf=0.537)
B2F kept: affinity-fixed-j2 beats best fixed on dev
aging: joint-a80 (fastest within best-fixed short-task slowdown)
final system: joint-checkpoint (fastest within best-fixed short-task slowdown)
short cutoff: 782.5 expected output tokens (dev median)
